dataset: EgoDex (Hoque et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.11709) — recorded Apple Vision Pro hand and head motion, replayed through MABEL's own headset wire format
note: every clip is the SAME episode its metrics row was scored on, snapshotted from that run rather than re-simulated

methods.label: Ours
methods.why: GMR keypoints plus the offline front-workspace posture atlas, per-finger keypoint IK, the standoff clamps, the head-anchor low-pass and the mobile-base re-anchor.

methods.label: Direct copy
methods.why: Copy the operator's joint angles onto the robot. A human arm is longer and a human torso about three times wider, so equal ANGLES do not put the hand in the same place.
